div.div:
Examples from our project
• CR-01 push notifications (Faculty of Business) → Deferred: it's scope creep and would eat our float.
• CR-02 clean-up mini-sprint + contractor → Approved: wins back about 8 of the 10 lost days, $23,800 from contingency.
• CR-03 MFA for everyone (Privacy Officer) → Approved: needed for APP 11, fits in the float.
